method: static read-only llvm-objdump -d --triple=thumbv7-linux-gnueabi; llvm-nm -D; strings -t x; prior static evidence cross-check

findings.finding: FeaIf::EncodeStill copies/enqueues an input descriptor asynchronously; it does not wait for JPEG completion or storage.
RecordStill prepares WriteStillParam and reaches MprCtrl::WriteStill; this is request construction, not writer completion.
FeaIf::WriteStill accepts one or two records, packages 0x90 bytes, and submits them through a virtual asynchronous interface.
The internal FeaCore WriteStill path validates state, writer availability, recording identifier, and active recording lines before queueing.
EXIF, thumbnail, JPEG main data, reserve, and screennail are separate areas; construction checks reserve and WriteDcfMemory prefixes EXIF/thumbnail to JPEG.
MprFileIfCore::WriteAndFlush validates handle, buffer and out-count, resets out-count, finds an MMgr, and delegates to its vtable slot +0x290.
MPR exports synchronous DCF pre-registration and directory/file-number-to-EntryId lookup APIs.
MPR exports DCF directory/content and thumbnail-playback APIs and contains the DCIM naming pattern \DCIM\%3ldMSDCF\DSC0%04ld.JPG.
No static edge proves that a submitted WriteStill record writes to SD, calls WriteAndFlush, invokes fsync/fdatasync, or reports durable completion.
No static edge connects WriteStill completion to DCF registration/commit/rollback, ObjMsg 0x3500/0x3002 consumption, cache invalidation, or playback visibility.
Writer-specific cancellation, partial-file cleanup, DMM release, and error recovery semantics were not recovered.
EncodeStill success, a valid JPEG, or a DSC filename string is not evidence of SD write, DCF registration, or playback visibility.
